## The Dolomites Collection

<!-- bm:section id=dolomites preset=dark label="Dolomites Section" -->
<!-- bm:var name=location value="Northern Italy" -->
<!-- bm:var name=season value="Autumn" -->

The jagged limestone peaks of the Dolomites offer a masterclass in texture and light.
Each morning, the frost paints a delicate lace over the valleys, creating a scene
that feels both ancient and fleeting.

<!-- bm:columns id=split-details weights=[2,1] label="Details" -->
<!-- bm:col label="The Experience" -->
## Texture of Stone
The Dolomites are a symphony of texture. The way the light catches on the
weathered rock faces creates a sense of depth that is impossible to ignore.
It is a landscape that demands to be felt as much as it is seen.

![Close up of rock texture](images/rock-texture.svg)

# About the Artist

<!-- bm:section id=about preset=light label="About Section" -->
<!-- bm:var name=technique value="Natural Light" -->

I believe that the best photographs are those that tell a story without
needing words. By waiting for the perfect alignment of light and atmosphere,
I aim to preserve the soul of the landscape.
